question: Does packed elimination, invariant square hoisting, monic roots and batched residual inversion preserve exact answers while removing whole-process simulated instructions on six fixed d12 controls?

claims.text: Exact old/new decisions and original witness order match; separate polynomial arithmetic checks known answers and saved points.
Report paired whole-cold-process instruction and separate field-work differences with identical outputs and baseline A/A.
Native runtime, external-best, scaling and full pipeline cost are not established.

arms.description: Byte-identical old linearized solver source snapshot
Identical baseline in independently interleaved fresh processes
Current production packed/batched solver with original replay

positive.not_applicable_reason: Positive planted and cancellation targets embedded in each arm and both largest-class pilots; every such query must Found/replay.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Uniform targets embedded in each arm with separate polynomial-arithmetic inconsistency proof; paired implementation comparison, not unusual structure claim.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: One executable contains exact retained old source and optimized production source; same compiler/field/group modules. Callgrind3.24 and its options fixed.

factors.name: instances
factors.how: Six disclosed existing d12 controls, fixed before new work comparison; old and new source see identical input bytes.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Rotate three arms by field index + kind index + replicate, five rounds.

factors.name: threads
factors.how: Single-threaded native solver; one CPU allocation and2GiB process address-space ceiling for the proposed local exception.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Recorded AMD EPYC9V74 virtual x86 host; CPU0, no PMU; simulated instructions only, no native timing claim.

factors.name: cache_and_layout
factors.how: Every counted and Callgrind query is a fresh process; no shared process-local field cache. All cold setup charged. ASLR variation read against A/A.

factors.name: preemption
factors.how: Outer600second total guard, no retries; raw process output and flushed JSONL prefixes retained.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Compiled deterministic summary is hashed before affected data, with no adaptive sample selection or population inference.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Rotate by field/kind/replicate; fresh child processes.

seed_derivation.note: Reuse exact fixed prior65-case workload; primary selection explicitly n83/131,d12,distinct-planted-0/uniform/cancellation.

instance_sampling.rule: Reuse exact fixed prior65-case workload; primary selection explicitly n83/131,d12,distinct-planted-0/uniform/cancellation.

blinding.how: Descriptive finite panel only; deterministic Rust summary and decision rules frozen before affected data, arm labels retained for reproducibility. No adaptive interpretation or population test.

power.note: Exact disclosed six-cell implementation comparison, paired five-repeat min/median/max and A/A; no population test or p-value.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: 12-call CPU0/2GiB engineering pilot including both largest bases; fixed field/arm max of positive/uniform times15 calls. Planning only, not timing evidence.

primary.name: Whole cold-process Callgrind Ir
primary.definition: Complete fresh executable including parsing, setup/admission, solve, roots/sign lifts and final replay; tally disabled. Simulated instruction work, never native runtime/cycles.

secondary.name: Native field multiply
secondary.definition: Cold exact native query field multiplies from fixture/variety construction through replay; parser excluded.

secondary.name: Native field square
secondary.definition: Cold exact native query field squares including inversion internals; parser excluded.

secondary.name: Informational inversion calls
secondary.definition: Diagnostic only, never added to inner field multiply/square costs.

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed6cases x3arms x5repetitions=90 primary rows; separate12-call largest-class pilot.
Stop on any invalid Found/Refuted result, preserving all rows.
Combined pilot/freeze/primary600seconds,2GiB/CPU0, no retries; every failed prefix retained.

decision_rule.text: Every cell needs identical outcomes and exact witness order,5 rows per arm, candidate medianIr at least5% lower and baseline A/A median difference<=1%; otherwise descriptive/inconclusive. Never infer native runtime.
decision_rule.statistic: Per-cell min/median/max whole-process simulatedIr and separate field counts
decision_rule.interval: Exact five-repeat ranges and baseline A/A medians; no population CI
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Fraction of whole-process simulated instructions removed on identical fixed queries

inadmissible: No timing, scaling, population, full-DLP or challenge-recovery claim.
UNKNOWN is not UNSAT; no row deletion, adaptive seeds or comparison of unpaired favorable subsets.
Native group counters exclude field/ANF, non-group inversions and SAT work; they are not a complete cost unit.

literature.claim: Known S3/Vieta and monic quadratic algebra, with Semaev/Diem references.

extensions.authorization: Continued explicit local1CPU/2GiB/600second panel exception, zero paid resources/retries.
extensions.preflight: 12calls: n83/131,d12,distinct-planted-1 and uniform, all3arms; positiveFound/replay and everyvalid required.
extensions.runtime_planning: Sum max pilot combined cost per field/arm times15 primary rows, plus actual fixed pilot elapsed.
extensions.external_comparison_gap: No external-best claim; M4RI/FLINT/Magma not a supplied matched full-query arm.
